topic: Steps 10–11: the Ibrahimi prayer (final tashahhud only) and ending the prayer

words.en: the Ibrahimi prayer (blessings on the Prophet)

words.ar: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ،
words.en: O Allah, send prayers upon Muhammad and the family of Muhammad,

words.ar: كَمَا صَلَّيْتَ عَلَى إِبْرَاهِيمَ وَعَلَى آلِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ،
words.en: as You sent prayers upon Ibrahim and the family of Ibrahim;
indeed You are Praiseworthy and Glorious.

words.ar: اللَّهُمَّ بَارِكْ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ،
words.en: O Allah, bless Muhammad and the family of Muhammad,

words.ar: كَمَا بَارَكْتَ عَلَى إِبْرَاهِيمَ وَعَلَى آلِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ،
words.en: as You blessed Ibrahim and the family of Ibrahim;
indeed You are Praiseworthy and Glorious.
Peace and the mercy of Allah be upon you

order.en: Build the Ibrahimi prayer in order

quiz.en: When do we say the Ibrahimi prayer?
How do we end the prayer?
opts: Turn the head right, then left

quiz.en: What do we say each time we turn?
opts: Peace and the mercy of Allah be upon you

move.ar: اِلْتَفِتْ يَمِينًا ثُمَّ يَسَارًا: السَّلَامُ عَلَيْكُمْ وَرَحْمَةُ اللهِ!
move.en: Turn your head to the right, then to the left — you just ended the prayer!

parents.summary: The Ibrahimi prayer in the final tashahhud, and ending the prayer with salām to the right and left.

try.en: Peace and the mercy of Allah be upon you

parents.tip: Pray one short prayer next to him and let him lead the ending.
